status.verifyOff: Token check turned off. Requests are accepted on the secret in the address alone.
status.verifyOn: Only requests carrying this token are accepted now.
status.rotated: New address created. Replace the webhook URL registered in Channel Talk with the new one.
status.prModeChanged: Auto-created fix PRs were switched to approval mode. Channel Talk is a feedback channel that needs no login, so a person reviews code changes before they are opened.
status.keySaved: Key verified and saved. Register the address below in Channel Talk.

keyStep.s1: Open Channel Talk Desk and click <kbd>Settings</kbd> at the top.
keyStep.s2: In the left list, go to <kbd>Security & Development</kbd> → <kbd>API</kbd>. The "Create API key" screen opens.
keyStep.s3: Click Create new key and enter a name. Anything recognizable, like Feedloop, will do.
keyStep.s4: You get an access key and an access secret. The secret is shown only this once, so copy it before you close the window.
keyStep.callout: On the free plan, "Create new key" can't be clicked. It doesn't even look greyed out, so nothing seems to happen when you click. That isn't a bug: keys can only be issued on paid plans. If you haven't paid yet, starting with the web widget is quicker.

webhook.s1: In the same <kbd>Settings</kbd> → <kbd>Security & Development</kbd>, open <kbd>Webhook</kbd> this time.
webhook.s2: Click <kbd>Create webhook</kbd>, then paste the address above into the URL field.
webhook.s3: Subscribe to user chat conversations and user chat opened. Feedloop reads only these two.
webhook.s4: After you save, Channel Talk shows a webhook token. Enter it in the field below and only requests carrying that token are accepted.

ct.verifyActive: The token is being checked. If you recreated the webhook in Channel Talk, enter the new token.

troubleshoot.loginOnly: If you put it in a layout that only logged-in people see, it won't show when logged out.
troubleshoot.cache: Your browser may be holding an old page. Try a hard refresh (⌘⇧R).
troubleshoot.title: I pasted it but nothing shows
troubleshoot.notDeployed: You may have saved but not deployed yet. On Vercel, Netlify and similar, changes apply only after the deploy finishes.
troubleshoot.edited: If you retyped the snippet by hand, check that the data-feedloop value matches the one above exactly. One wrong character and it never reaches us.

overview.footnote: The Connected status stays once anything has come in. Removing the script or removing the webhook doesn't turn it off by itself. When you want to, use “Disconnect” on the card. To delete the bot itself, do it from the “Bots” list.

locked.title: Already receiving through {using}
locked.body1: Each bot has only one feedback channel. If the same customer writes in through two channels, the record of where you answered splits, and the two channels offer different features.
locked.body2: To move to {want}, first “Disconnect” {using} on the “Connect your bot” screen. The conversations and feedback collected so far aren't deleted.{hint}
locked.widgetHint: First delete the widget script line from your site's code.
locked.sideBody: Each bot has only one feedback channel. To move to {want}, first click “Disconnect” next to {using}.

chooser.channelBody: Attaches to the chat you already use. Feedloop reads and triages incoming inquiries, and replies stay with your support team as they are now.
chooser.widgetNeed: You just need to add one line of code to your site · step 1
chooser.widgetBody: Shows a chat bubble on your site. AI answers what visitors write right there, and hands off to the owner when it doesn't know. When a fix ships, that visitor is told right away.
chooser.widgetTitle: I don't have a support chat yet
chooser.question: How do you receive customer inquiries right now?
chooser.channelNeed: You need a paid Channel Talk plan to issue an API key · step 3
chooser.limitNoLimit: One feedback channel per bot. If you change your mind later, disconnect the current one and connect the other. AI replies go out on your own API key with no limit either way, and you are billed through that key.
chooser.limitFree: One feedback channel per bot. If you change your mind later, disconnect the current one and connect the other. AI replies go out either way: up to {limit, number} a day, free, and with your own API key there is no limit.
chooser.limitOverridden: One feedback channel per bot. If you change your mind later, disconnect the current one and connect the other. AI replies go out either way: up to {limit, number} a day.

lastFeedback.none: No feedback has come in yet
lastFeedback.invalid: Couldn't read the last feedback time

status.pausedNote: Automatic checking stopped after a long wait. Once you finish connecting, click Check again.

widget.title: Reset the widget's Connected status?
widget.body: This only clears the “Connected” status. If the script is still on your site, it becomes “Connected” again the next time a visitor opens the widget. If you are moving to Channel Talk, remove the script from your site first, then reset the status. Conversations and feedback stay as they are.

channel.title: Disconnect Channel Talk?
channel.body: The saved key and webhook address are deleted, so nothing comes in from Channel Talk anymore. Names and contact details in conversations that came through Channel Talk are anonymized; the message text stays. Remove the webhook registration on the Channel Talk side yourself.
